## Description {#details}

Struct template specialisation for extracting function traits from non-const member function types.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="R">The return type of the member function.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="T">The class type to which the member function belongs.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="...Args_T">The argument types of the member function.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
This specialisation of the <code>function&#95;traits</code> struct template provides compile-time introspection for non-const member function types. It exposes the return type and argument types of a member function, enabling advanced template metaprogramming and type deduction within the µTest++ framework.

The <code><a href="#a1f21557f758a46166726e0c6e01ee8bc">result&#95;type</a></code> member defines the return type of the member function, while the <code>args</code> member is a type list containing all argument types.
